verdicts.typography: Flawless Swiss-style hierarchy. The mono uppercase micro-labels (section numbers, stat captions, table headers) are perfectly disciplined. Heading scale from the massive hero down to body copy shows excellent rhythm. Weight contrast between bold headings and regular body is precise. No orphans, no cramped lines, tracking is tight and professional throughout.
verdicts.color: Strictly minimalist single-accent discipline executed perfectly. One red variable used consistently for the hero word 'this?', section numbers, matrix marks, the 'THIS SYSTEM' column rule/header, verdict highlight, and UI dots. Near-black on white provides excellent contrast. No off-brand colors, no visual noise. Any tiny tonal variation is standard font anti-aliasing, not a color defect.
verdicts.layout: Excellent grid alignment and whitespace rhythm overall, with one concrete visible defect: in the Analysis grid (screenshot d4), the vertical hairline border between column 3 ('Different data requirements') and column 4 ('THE RESULT') extends downward past the bottom border of the upper row (cards 1-3), creating a visible T-junction misalignment with the lower row (cards 4-5). All other layout elements—container max-width, consistent padding, intact hairline borders elsewhere, and footer positioning—are flawless.
verdicts.components: Publication-grade component quality. The matrix table is exemplary: legible mark legend, perfect sticky first-column behavior with functional shadow during horizontal scroll (d9), and the final 'THIS SYSTEM' column is correctly distinguished by a 2px red left rule and red header text. Accordion list shows clear affordances (chevrons). Stat strip, sticky header/nav, and footer are all impeccably built.
verdicts.responsive: Flawless execution across all breakpoints and modes. Mobile layout (390px) maintains strict typographic hierarchy, correct vertical stacking, and zero horizontal overflow. The wide matrix table handles horizontal scrolling elegantly with a sticky first column and clear 'SWIPE TO COMPARE' affordance. Dark mode demonstrates a consistent, high-contrast monochromatic palette with the signature red accent preserved. No visual defects detected.

layout: In the Analysis section grid (d4), fix the vertical divider between the third and fourth columns so it terminates exactly at the horizontal border separating the first row of cards (1-3) from the second row (4-5), eliminating the current overhang/T-junction misalignment.
